120-unit 100% affordable housing development serving individuals and families earning 30 to 70% of AMI, and one manager’s unit. Ground floor of the building will include a property management office, space for resident managers and administrators to meet with residents, and an employee break room. It will also include a community room where residents can gather for events and school-age children can do homework. There will be Wi-Fi throughout the building, including free individual Wi-Fi modems in each unit. Picnic tables and children’s play areas. All-electric with solar panels.

712 Seagaze is located in downtown Oceanside, CA and will be a high-rise building with 179 units with 177 unit reserved for families earning 30 to 60% AMI, and 2 manager’s units. The building will include a community room on-site resident services and property management offices. The site is within close proximity to the Oceanside Transit Center. Additional amenities include a swimming pool, bicycle storage, and fitness area.
